scope: Research and explicit synthetic-policy acceptance; live source/automatic UI not implemented

contract.scope: Pure anonymous synthetic policy only. Manual app mode remains unchanged. No sensor adapter/start, permission/discovery, identity or authentication authority.
contract.multiple_observations: Farthest supplied valid observation controls readability; all detections in this supplied frame must have distance estimates. This is NOT proof of all occupants or people outside/occluded in the camera view.
contract.ordering: Ephemeral source token, increasing sequence and same-clock capture time; expired tokens and old sequences cannot mutate the current source or its clock. Host receipt time is finite, nonnegative and monotonic. No wall-clock or user identity inferred.
contract.source_loss: Missing/partial/low-quality/malformed/too-old frame -> manual density and zero motion. Empty detection is unknown, NOT proof of absence. Silence at 3 seconds -> manual fallback. Recovery needs fresh dwell. Manual override invalidates token.
contract.motion: Finite normalized synthetic vector, clipped components and time-based low-pass; first frame/gap reset is zero. Not inferred from device accelerometer or a claimed original Apple motion algorithm.
required_cases: manual default and explicit synthetic start
stable near/far trace and hysteresis-band jitter
dwell plus three unique frames; duplicate and out-of-order rejection
bounded gap; stale silence and recovery
multiple supplied people and partial observations
old source/sequence cannot affect newer source or its clock
manual override prevents late synthetic results
same-clock capture age/future timestamp and monotonic receipt validation
contract.non_acceptance: No original F010/F016 parity, physical iPad depth/UWB support, real human-distance accuracy, live room motion, identity, biometric/presence authentication, Home or automatic source selection claimed. Issue closure must be evaluated against the original explicitly synthetic acceptance, not assumed here.

watch_scope: Reduced Watch target does not include the new policy; Watch SDK build is regression only

existing_solution.decision: No dependency, code or models adopted/installed/run. Apple public frameworks provide candidate observations; neither supplies this own lifecycle/hysteresis policy. MediaPipe hip-origin world coordinates are not a direct display-distance measurement.
existing_solution.host_compatibility: Not built or installed; no compatibility/accuracy/model-license claim
existing_solution.privacy_notice: Current README says input processing stays on device but performance/utilization metrics are sent to Google. Not activated here.

retained_initial_boundaries.reason: Initial probe included AVCaptureDepthDataOutput on macOS, explicitly unavailable there; corrected platform guard. Not reclassified as an expected-negative PASS or whole-Mac depth ban.
retained_initial_boundaries.truncated_source: Initial 24k MediaPipe iOS page excluded; complete 34k retry is the cited input.
